title: Disney 1928 yilda Osvald quyonni yo'qotib, Mikki Mausni yaratgan

scenes.text: 1928 yilda Uolt Disney o'z multfilm qahramoni Osvald quyon huquqidan ayrildi.
U bilan birga ko'p animatorlari ham distribyutor tomonga o'tib ketdi.
O'sha yili Disney Ab Aywerks bilan yangi qahramon, Mikki Mausni yaratdi.
1928 yil 18 noyabrda ovozli Steamboat Willie multfilmi namoyish etildi.
Mikki studiyaning eng mashhur qahramoniga aylandi.
Yo'qotgan narsang o'rnini yangi ish to'ldirishi mumkin.
scenes.keywords: young man starting to draw at night

description: 1928 yilda Uolt Disney Osvald quyon huquqidan va ko'p animatorlaridan ayrildi, o'sha yili esa Ab Aywerks bilan Mikki Mausni yaratdi. 18 noyabr 1928 yilda ovozli Steamboat Willie namoyish etildi. Sen nimani yo'qotgandan keyin to'xtab qolding?
source: Britannica: Walt Disney's First Cartoon Critter Was Not Mickey Mouse (Mintz hired away Disney's animators; Disney did not own Oswald), https://www.britannica.com/story/walt-disneys-first-cartoon-critter ; Walt Disney Family Museum: Ub Iwerks (nearly all of the staff defected to Mintz; Iwerks and Les Clark stayed), https://www.waltdisney.org/blog/ub-iwerks-master-animation-and-technology ; Library of Congress National Film Registry essay: Steamboat Willie, https://www.loc.gov/static/programs/national-film-preservation-board/documents/steamboat_willie.pdf ; D23: Steamboat Willie Premieres (Colony Theater, 18 Nov 1928), https://d23.com/this-day/steamboat-willie-premieres/ . Note: some sources date the staff raid to late 1927; Oswald rights were lost in early 1928.
